summary: RELIANCE on NSE and a currency future on CDS share token 2885: each packet goes to the instrument of its packet type's segment only.

deviations.reason: HDFC Sky sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).

A cash equity's packet carries no OI (proto3 writes oi 0); the web sends that 0 as oi and open_interest instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376). The desktop counts OI on the derivative segments only. Lead decision: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out, web defect.
